title: Recover A Header-Only Match With An Explicit Story ID
task: Using docxedit only, work with a document whose header holds text that does not appear in the main story.
Show that a main-story text selector does not match the header text and record the diagnostic.
Discover the header paragraph ID with read or find using headers-footers coverage.
Recover with an explicit H001 paragraph ID plus a guard, running check before apply, and validate the output.
successCriteria: Shows the main-story selector failing with E1201 on header-only text.
Produces an output .docx with only the header paragraph changed.
Does not inspect raw OOXML package parts or quote private document text.
observerQuestions: Did the agent find the headers-footers discovery flag without hints?
Was the main-story scope of semantic selectors legible from help or docs?
Could the agent verify that only the header changed?
